title: Turing pattern wavelength is set by reaction and diffusion, not tissue size
look_for_in_this_kingdom: zebrafish and other fish stripes, mouse digits and palatal rugae, feather and hair follicle spacing, felid coats, chameleon and lizard skin; wavelength vs body size or perturbation experiments
variables_needed: pattern spacing or wavelength per individual
perturbation of diffusion or reaction parameters

claims.label: Turing wavelength selection
claims.statement: The spacing of a Turing pattern at onset is set by the reaction rates and diffusivities, not by the size of the tissue, so changing these parameters predictably changes the number of repeated elements.

other_kingdoms_hint.plants: stomatal, trichome, root-hair and leaf-pattern spacing; Arabidopsis patterning mutants; experimental and modelled wavelength vs domain size
other_kingdoms_hint.fossils: fossil skin, feather and colour patterns (pigment preservation), fossil digit and rugae counts, stromatolite and trace-fossil spacing; say plainly when thin

organisms_datasets: test-data/organisms/merged/datasets.json (provenanced dataset records keyed by taxon; reuse by id where it covers your variables)
